units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 2:3:3">Y. Kil. II, 27ᵈ</cite> <he>גָּם כרמייא</he> razed his vineyards.
<cite ref="Chullin 50a:5">Ḥull. 50ᵃ</cite> <he>גּוֹם שדי</he> peel it off and throw it away.
<cite ref="Chullin 92b:14">Ib. 92ᵇ</cite> <he>גָּאִים ליה</he> ed. (Ar. <cite ref="C00706"><he>גיים</he></cite>) peeled it off (on the surface, opp. <he>מרטט</he>). Ib. 96ᵃ

senses.gloss: as <cite ref="C01054">preced.</cite> Nif. Ib. 44ᵃ <he>אִיגּוֹם אִיגּוּמֵי וכ׳</he> the chin was razed, detached without laceration from the neck, opp. <he>איעקור</he> forcibly torn off.
units: <cite ref="Bekhorot 44a:15">Bekh. 44ᵃ</cite> <he>אִיגּוּם איגומי</he> the horns are levelled (not projecting), opp. <he>איעקור</he> uprooted.
